description: Runs the shop application's original checkout, outbox and job functions against a disposable PostgreSQL database, one process per actor execution; the payment provider and the event bus are coordinator-hosted test doubles.

payOrderIdempotent.description: Checkout with a client request id sent to the provider as idempotency key.

shipOrderDualWrite.description: Commit the shipped status, then publish the event.

shipOrderWithOutbox.description: Shipped status and outbox row in one Drizzle transaction.

relayOutbox.description: One pass of the outbox relay.

sendReceiptOnce.description: Queue consumer claiming the effect with a unique row first.

reserveStock.description: Reservation with a warehouse notification inside the retried transaction.

reserveStockNotifyAfterCommit.description: Reservation notifying the warehouse after commit.
